environment.description: Django REST API deployed on ECS Fargate in isolated subnets (no IGW route, no NAT for inbound). Service is fronted by a Network Load Balancer (NLB) registered as an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The NLB resides in private subnets with no internet gateway attachment. VPC endpoint interface connections are restricted via endpoint policy to principal 'arn:aws:iam::111222333444:root' (single consumer account). The NLB security group allows inbound only from the VPC CIDR 10.0.0.0/16. There is no public DNS record, no internet gateway in the VPC, and the subnet route tables contain only local routes and VPC endpoint routes. The service is additionally configured with VPC endpoint service acceptance required (AcceptanceRequired: true), meaning new endpoint connections must be manually approved.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate in isolated private subnets
config.load_balancer: NLB (internal) registered as PrivateLink endpoint service
